source.where: (FacilitySitePoint.featurecode = 'Boat Ramp / Dock' AND (FacilitySitePoint.name LIKE 'Little Wolf River Public Access%' OR FacilitySitePoint.name LIKE 'Waupaca River Public Access%' OR FacilitySitePoint.name LIKE 'Crystal River Public Access%' OR FacilitySitePoint.name = 'Shadow Lake Boat Launch')) OR FacilitySitePoint.name = 'Woods Park Canoe/Kayak Access'
source.note: County facility records are candidates, not automatic landing verification. Placed-on-map locations may be offset or refer to a different access. County trip guides and imagery must support each selected access; duplicate facility IDs stay in review.
